name: create_goal
description:
Create a goal only when explicitly requested by the user or system/developer instructions; do not infer goals from ordinary tasks.
Set token_budget only when an explicit token budget is requested. Fails if a goal exists; use update_goal only for status.

objective.description: Required. The concrete objective to start pursuing. This starts a new active goal only when no goal is currently defined; if a goal already exists, this tool fails.

token_budget.description: Optional positive token budget for the new active goal.
